description: How many of a model (or kind of car) are for sale in a market, the median advertised price and mileage, the price range, and the share priced under market. Use it for questions like 'what does a used Camry cost in Dallas' or 'is now a good time'.

market.description: Market slug from list_markets. Optional if the query names the city.

query.description: A model or kind of car, with new or used, for example 'used Toyota Camry', 'new Ford F-150', 'used SUV under $30k'.

name: market_summary
title: Summarize a market
